body_paragraphs: Anthropic, which makes the Claude AI chatbot, raised $91.6 billion before its shares rose nearly 17% on Thursday. On Friday, they fell 8.50%, close to the $83 price set for the debut. The Nasdaq, which includes many technology companies, erased all its gains for the year.
Investors questioned whether heavy AI spending will earn enough money, especially as companies borrow more to fund it. U.S. government bonds attracted investors seeking safer places for their money.
